description: This file defines type aliases for callback functions related to handling chunks of file data during download or processing, including progress tracking.

methods.name: OnChunkCallback
methods.description: Type alias for an asynchronous callback invoked with a data chunk, its index, a boolean indicating if it's the last chunk, and download progress.

methods.name: OnChunkCallbackNoProgress
methods.description: Type alias for an asynchronous callback invoked with a data chunk, its index, and a boolean indicating if it's the last chunk, without progress info.

ctags.name: OnChunkCallbackNoProgress
ctags.pattern: /^export type OnChunkCallbackNoProgress = (chunk: { data: Uint8Array; index: number; isLast: boole/
